prompt: The Help Center route (src/routes/_authenticated/help-center/index.tsx) only shows a coming-soon page. Replace it with a Help Center page in src/features/help-center/: a heading "Help Center", a search field labelled "Search questions", and these five questions, each opening to show its answer when clicked: "How do I reset my password?" — "Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you." "Can I change my email address?" — "Yes, in Settings › Account." "How do I invite a teammate?" — "Open Users and choose "Invite User"." "Where can I download invoices?" — "Invoices are emailed to the account owner each month." "How do I delete my account?" — "Write to support and we will do it within two working days.". The search filters the questions as the user types; when none matches, show "No answer matches your search" with a "Clear search" button. Use the same page layout as the other pages (header, main).

constraints.text: Built from the app's existing components (Collapsible, Input, Button, the layout's Header and Main), not new hand-made ones.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
All closed, one open, a search with results, a search with none, in the dark theme and in a narrow window.
Each question is a button that says whether it is expanded; the search field has its label; the no-match message is announced.
Only the Help Center's route and its new feature folder change; the coming-soon component stays for the pages that use it, and no test is removed.
